items.reason: Describes the same compatibility break from adding abstract order(): legacy providers can throw AbstractMethodError during provider detection.
Concerns AuthzClient initialization locking the global provider to the client's classloader. This differs from the golden issue about equal-priority providers being selected by discovery order.
Concerns missing DER sequence boundary and trailing-byte validation in readSequence, which no golden issue describes.
Concerns negative or oversized DER integers being mangled by integerToBytes. This differs from the golden issue about incorrect JOSE input length in the opposite conversion.
Concerns unchecked exceptions from invalid DER integer lengths in readInteger/readLength. Neither the golden JOSE-length issue nor S3's sequence-boundary problem describes this same defect.
